$comment: Machine-readable policy for the issue #231 release packaging guard. The guard (tools/release_packaging_guard.py) reads THIS file plus data/sources/game_system_rights.json, so the excluded-licence set has exactly one home (the ledger) and the packaging rules have exactly one home (here). Do not add a second exclusion list anywhere. Records PACKAGING RULES ONLY: no licence is selected by this file, no LICENSE/NOTICE file is created, and nothing here is a legal clearance.
$excluded_licence_decisions_note: These are EXACT keys of the rights ledger's decision_vocabulary. The guard errors if any key here stops existing in the ledger (drift), and errors if any artifact class declares one of them. Do not rename them here without renaming them in the ledger.
$documented_mention_markers_note: Excluded-licence names that legitimately appear in provenance/conscience prose. The guard reports these as an INVENTORY (warnings), never as errors: README.md and RULEBOOK.md state that the game contains NC-derived material, and the audit records name the licences they audit. Flagging those as failures would be a false positive.

artifact_classes.note: Original creative rulebook and worldbook prose.
The rules in machine-readable syntax; grouped with the rulebook, not with the code. Scenario and dialogue data ships with the rules because it is content, not code.
artifact_classes._restart_note: The restart rulebook (#827) is author-written; no third-party material is imported into it.

artifact_classes.note: Rights ledgers, licence plan and provenance inventories. Must follow the rulebook, not a software licence. Asset manifests record source and licence status per pack.
Design, audit, scenario and record material. Publication scope of .hermes/ agent plans is an author decision.

The imported Ubiquitous Maniacs legacy tree and its import record. First-party material imported from the author's own CC0-1.0 working material, so it carries no third-party obligation and follows the author's own licence decision like the rest of the repository. It is LEGACY: it does not override the current rules in RULEBOOK.md / rulebook/, and the active game's rules live in strategy_game/. The source tree is incomplete - its data/ directory was never committed to the source repository - so the imported code is an archive, not a running game. See docs/import/UBIQUITOUS_MANIACS_LEGACY_IMPORT.md.

Needs its own software licence, separate from the CC instrument. pytest.ini is test configuration: it tells pytest which directories not to collect, so the preserved corpora under archive/ do not shadow this repository's own src/ package. It is configuration for the test suite, so it travels with the code it configures.
Godot project files are code, not prose.

release_modes.$comment: A 'public' release cannot be declared clean while the author's licence decision is open. Use 'audit' for dry runs and a full-tree scan; 'public' is the release-gate mode.
release_modes.audit: Full-tree scan reports findings as warnings and passes while the tree is internally consistent, even with the author decision open.
release_modes.public: Fails while any artifact class is still 'author-decision'.
